seo.title: Set Easy — Gym Workout Tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: Set Easy is a strength training log for iPhone and Apple Watch. Today's workout is ready with your last weights filled in: check off each set, rest with a Lock Screen timer, and see every personal best. No account.

hero.label: STRENGTH TRAINING
hero.title: Lift more, type less.
text: Set Easy is a strength training log that gets out of the way. Today's workout is ready when you are, with the weights you lifted last time already filled in. Check off each set, rest, and go again.

items.title: Today's workout
items.text: Your workouts take turns, so the one you did longest ago is up next and a push, pull and legs rotation stays in order. Pick another any time, or start an empty workout.

items.title: Log a set in one tap
items.text: Every set shows what you did last time. Adjust the weight or reps if you need to, check it off, and the rest timer starts on its own.

items.title: Personal bests
items.text: Lift more than ever before and Set Easy marks it with a trophy. Hit the same top weight twice and it suggests a little more next time.

items.title: Rest timer on the Lock Screen
items.text: A Live Activity shows the countdown and what's next on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Skip a tap away.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Log from your wrist with the Digital Crown, with last time's weights ready. Finished workouts go to History on your iPhone.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Turn it on in Settings to save finished workouts as strength training and see your average and highest heart rate for each one.

items.title: History and progress
items.text: A calendar of every workout, charts for each exercise, weekly volume and the muscles you've worked this week.

items.title: Bring your history
items.text: Import from Strong or Hevy, export everything as a CSV file, and back up or restore all your data in one file.

sections.title: Who it's for
items: Lifters running push, pull and legs, upper and lower, or full body splits
People who want to log a set without typing
Apple Watch wearers who leave their phone in the bag

sections.title: Privacy
text: Set Easy has no accounts, no analytics and no ads. Your training history stays on your device. Workouts go to Apple Health only if you turn it on, and health data never leaves your iPhone and Apple Health.

cta.title: Ready to lift?
cta.text: Set Easy is coming soon to the App Store. No account required.
